newsitem.title: MEXICO: Condumex offers to buy Latinca shares.
newsitem.headline: Condumex offers to buy Latinca shares.

text.p: Grupo Condumex, a subsidiary of Mexican industrial conglomerate Grupo Carso, said on Friday it has begun a public offering to buy up to 143,176,988 shares in Conductores Latincasa SA de CV (Latinca) .

Condumex, an electoral manufacturer, is offering to buy 11.67 percent of Latinca's share capital through purchases of series A and B shares, the company said in a statement released by the Mexican Stock Exchange.
It will pay 0.415 peso per share, while the whole offer will total 59.42 million pesos.
The offer remains open from August 1 to 15. Inversora Bursatil (Inbursa) is managing the transaction.
On 19 March Condumex said it intended to acquire 52 percent of Latinca's capital.
